newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch money rates at standstill in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Dutch money rates at standstill in moderate trade.

text.p: Dutch money rates continued to be traded at or near previous levels on Monday and dealers said rates were not likely to alter much in the near term.
Volumes were moderate all along the curve, with dealers noting only minor interest for one-year deposits.
Call money was bid between 2.75-81 percent versus 2.81 percent last Friday. Other deposits were unchanged, with only one-year paper bid two basis points lower at 3.18 percent.
"But, there is hardly any action in this duration," said one dealer.
The guilder was stable at 112.165 per 100 marks.
